api_url.label: API URL
api_url.description: URL of the LRCLib API (including 'api' but excluding '/get')

always_use.label: Always use LRCLIB, regardless of existing lyrics
always_use.description: By default, LRCLIB is skipped for a track that already has lyrics from another source. Enable this to always query LRCLIB and let its result take priority, overwriting any lyrics already found.

manifest.description: Primary lyrics provider, delivering synced and unsynced lyrics from the LrcLib database.
